name_zh: 巴林·哈马德：改革珍珠与什叶逊尼沙特桥梁
name_en: Bahrain Hamad: Reform Pearls & Shia-Sunni Saudi Bridge
description_zh: 哈马德·本·伊萨·阿勒哈利法 (1950-) 巴林国王 (1999-)，2001年宪法改革设立议会，珍珠产业历史转型金融中心，什叶多数逊尼统治张力常态化，沙特桥梁战略依赖，2011珍珠圆环镇压。
description_en: Hamad bin Isa Al Khalifa (1950-) Bahrain King (1999-), 2001 constitutional reform established parliament, pearl industry history transformed to financial hub, Shia majority Sunni ruling tension normalized, Saudi bridge strategic dependence, 2011 Pearl Roundabout crackdown.
reason_zh: 哈马德代表海湾君主国如何在什叶多数逊尼统治张力中通过改革与外部依赖维持统治，展示了珍珠经济向金融中心转型的结构性困境，其沙特桥梁依赖定义了巴林生存空间边界。
reason_en: Hamad represents how Gulf monarchy maintains rule amid Shia majority Sunni ruling tension through reform and external dependence, demonstrating pearl economy to financial hub structural dilemma, his Saudi bridge dependence defining Bahrain survival space boundaries.
steps_zh: 研究哈马德早年英国军校与1999年继位
分析2001年国家行动宪章与两院制议会建立
探讨珍珠产业衰退与离岸金融中心崛起
评估2011珍珠圆环抗议与沙特半岛盾牌部队干预
总结改革珍珠什叶逊尼沙特桥梁对巴林生存空间的界定
steps_en: Study Hamad early British military academy and 1999 accession
Analyze 2001 National Action Charter and bicameral parliament establishment
Explore pearl industry decline and offshore financial hub rise
Evaluate 2011 Pearl Roundabout protests and Saudi Peninsula Shield Force intervention
Summarize reform pearls Shia-Sunni Saudi bridge defining Bahrain survival space
expected_zh: 理解什叶逊尼张力如何在外部大国干预下固化为统治合法性危机，掌握经济转型与政治改革不同步的海湾困境，评估巴林模式对东部省沙特内部平衡的外溢影响。
expected_en: Understand how Shia-Sunni tension solidifies into ruling legitimacy crisis under external great power intervention, grasp Gulf dilemma of economic transformation and political reform asynchrony, evaluate Bahrain model spillover impact on Eastern Province Saudi internal balance.
case_zh: 1999 国王；2001 改革；2011 镇压；持续。改革珍珠什叶逊尼沙特桥梁范式永存。
case_en: 1999 King; 2001 reform; 2011 crackdown; ongoing. Reform pearls Shia-Sunni Saudi bridge paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Constitutional reform; pearl economy; Shia-Sunni tension; Saudi bridge
